title: Click a link and assert the next page
summary: Drive a real browser: click About and check the URL and heading.
description: The smallest useful UX test: open the sample UI, click a nav link, and assert the destination. Compare Playwright and Cypress on the same js-ui pages.
architecture: A real Chromium (Playwright) or Electron/Chrome (Cypress) loads samples/js-ui over HTTP. The test clicks the About link like a user, then asserts the URL contains about.html and the h1 is “About this counter”. No unit-style imports — the browser is the client.

variants.label: Playwright
variants.notes: Playwright starts samples/js-ui via webServer, then drives Chromium.

variants.label: Cypress
variants.notes: start-server-and-test boots js-ui, then cypress run (headed: false).
